_spine: The guest-need ESSENTIALS taxonomy — AMO as the invisible operating layer of the city. Every essential entry is HIGH (official/primary-sourced) or clearly REFERENCE/VERIFY. A category with fewer than live_gate VERIFIED entries is HIDDEN from users and Luna declines it — no empty shelves, no fake coverage. Occasion collections nest under need-states by collection_key. Seeded ONLY from verified sources: trust_knowledge.json (Decreto 0051 fares, emergency 123, water/tipping), the Aug-2026 Tourist Trust/Safety research, and CARTAGENA_KNOWLEDGE. Situational/partner-backed categories fill via the partner self-service portal (moderation-gated), never manual bulk-load.

categories.guidance_es: Operadores: Claro, Movistar, Tigo, WOM. La cobertura varía por operador — confirmá la del tuyo antes de un tour a islas/pueblos. Comprá en tiendas oficiales o el aeropuerto — llevá tu pasaporte para registrar la SIM. Las eSIM (Airalo/Holafly) funcionan sin trámite.
categories.guidance_en: Carriers: Claro, Movistar, Tigo, WOM. Coverage varies by carrier — confirm yours before an island/town tour. Buy at official stores or the airport — bring your passport to register the SIM. eSIMs (Airalo/Holafly) work with no paperwork.
categories.guidance_fr: Opérateurs : Claro, Movistar, Tigo, WOM. La couverture varie selon l'opérateur — vérifiez celle du vôtre avant une excursion vers les îles/villages. Achetez en boutique officielle ou à l'aéroport — apportez votre passeport pour enregistrer la SIM. Les eSIM (Airalo/Holafly) fonctionnent sans formalité.

categories.guidance_es: Los taxis NO tienen taxímetro — acordá el precio ANTES de subir. Tarifa mínima 2026: $12.250 (en la práctica se redondea a $13.000). Recargo nocturno 7pm–5am: ~$1.100.
categories.guidance_en: Taxis have NO meter — agree the price BEFORE getting in. 2026 minimum fare: $12,250 (rounded to ~$13,000 in practice). Night surcharge 7pm–5am: ~$1,100.
categories.guidance_fr: Les taxis N'ONT PAS de compteur — convenez du prix AVANT de monter. Tarif minimum 2026 : $12.250 (arrondi à $13.000 en pratique). Supplément de nuit 19h–5h : ~$1.100.
categories.guidance_pt: Os táxis NÃO têm taxímetro — combine o preço ANTES de entrar. Tarifa mínima 2026: $12.250 (na prática, arredonda para $13.000). Adicional noturno 19h–5h: ~$1.100.

categories.guidance_es: Uber, InDrive, DiDi y Cabify funcionan en Cartagena. La ventaja: la tarifa se muestra ANTES — es tu mejor herramienta anti-estafa vs. el taxi sin taxímetro. De noche, incluso para trayectos cortos, usá app o taxi.
